'Recommended actions (from action codes)

• C-C3.1 — Customer Retention Intervention
  Owner: commercial_controlling_lead
  Trigger: crm.retention.pct < 0.94%
  Impact: High, RevenueUplift
  Expected: 1.0–4.0 pp
  Confidence: Medium
  · IDENTIFY segments or customers with persistent retention deterioration
  · PRIORITIZE the book of business by crm.revenue_at_risk.amount and crm.clv.amount
  · ASSIGN targeted recovery actions to account or CRM owners
  ⚠ Trigger only if revenue at risk is materially increasing for the same segment or customer set
  ⚠ Do not trigger for onboarding cohorts within their first 90 days

• C-C3.2 — Complaint & Advocacy Recovery
  Owner: commercial_controlling_lead
  Trigger: crm.nps.index < 5index
  Impact: Medium, RevenueUplift
  Expected: 5.0–15.0 index
  Confidence: Medium
  · IDENTIFY segments or products with falling advocacy and rising complaints
  · MAP the complaint pattern to channel, product, and customer ownership
  · EXECUTE recovery actions and close the highest-value issue clusters first
  ⚠ Trigger only if complaint trend is rising for the same segment, channel, or category
  ⚠ Do not trigger when survey coverage is below the agreed minimum sample size'
